description: The source file 'Program.cs' is an ASP.NET Core web application startup configuration that sets up services, middleware, and API endpoints for a data asset management system. It includes configuration for Swagger/OpenAPI, health checks, validation utilities, and numerous REST API routes for managing assets, their properties, lineage, status logs, and related entities, following a Flyway V2 schema.
